_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 11 fixed input. One cell. Everything it needs was MEASURED before the cut -- the probe names, their expected render, the suite's baseline and the unreachable branch's site -- so no arm is a fishing expedition. Every figure carries a `claim`.

scope_source.S86: the round-10 test asserts only the census instance's own shape, so it would pass the very substitution G43R10-AC5 exists to rule out. THE FIX GENERALISES AND THE TEST DOES NOT, AND THE TEST IS WHAT OUTLIVES THE ROUND.
scope_source.S87: R3's FIRM branch is implemented and can never be observed -- FN1b subtracts its token as a duplicate of the scope slot. Not a defect; an implemented-and-unobservable branch is dead code wearing a live appearance, and the fact must be carried AT THE SITE.
scope_source.the_analysis_bar: 'This is NOT new test design and must not be scoped as if it were: the inputs exist, the expectation is measured, the run has happened. It must FAIL against the keyed-substitution mutant; that mutant is the positive control.'

probes.claim: measured -- by the issuer at the cut pin, running grade() itself rather than reading the row
probes.why_these_two: Each differs from the census instance on the axis the round-10 test cannot see: the firm token sits AFTER the bd as well as before, and the bd sits at a token index the census instance never occupies. A substitution keyed to the census name renders neither.

suite_baseline.rule: Both are HAND-SIDE STALE worked cases and the round-9 analysis refuses counting them as agreement. The failing SET must be unchanged: no new failure, neither silenced.

unreachable_branch.branch: the FIRM reading -- `v.short[v.bd_firm]`, the else arm of _bd_is_vendor
unreachable_branch.why_unobservable: every path that reaches it produces a token FN1b then subtracts as a duplicate of the scope slot R4 filled with the same reading
unreachable_branch.what_is_owed: a comment AT THE SITE naming (a) that the branch has no observable output today, (b) the R3 + FN1b composition that makes it so, and (c) LGIC_ENFORCE-S87 as the record. The branch STAYS -- removing it needs a proof the composition can never change, which nobody has.

census.rule: Round 11 writes a TEST and a COMMENT. It must move NOTHING: re-grading the census at the end of this round yields the same 2 moved rows round 10 named, and no others.

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the round-10 analysis's bar, adopted as an arm
stale_proof_bar.statement: When a FIXED INPUT changes mid-round, every proof pinned before that change against that input is STALE-UNGRADED until re-run; the round enumerates them and prints the count.
stale_proof_bar.discriminator: git log --since=<the round's cut> -- <fixed-input path> -- a command that usually returns zero, so the bar costs nothing when nothing moved
stale_proof_bar.why_it_exists: S32's UNDERSTATE was caught only because an arm was re-run at L9, which no limb requires. The MIRROR is the dangerous one: a fixed input that REGRESSES after a pin leaves a proof reading PASS while the arm now FAILS, and a pinned proof carries its own vintage but NOT its input's.
